visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with styled black hair stands in a bright, modern apartment interior. He holds up a pair of black dress pants on a white plastic hanger and a dark navy suit jacket. He is dressed in a light blue and white checkered button-down shirt. The background features a sleek kitchen with dark cabinets and a ceiling fan with dark wooden blades. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the man's hands as he meticulously buttons the cuffs of his checkered shirt. A tan bandage is visible on his right index finger. The background is blurred, emphasizing the detailed hand movements involved in fastening the garment. (3) Returning to a medium shot, the man holds the black pants in front of his legs while wearing dark boxers. He then steps into the trousers, pulls them up to his waist, and fastens them, tucking the shirt in neatly. The room's lighting is bright and consistent. (4) He presents a variety of ties before selecting a dark brown tie with white polka dots. He drapes the tie around his neck, pops his shirt collar, and begins tying a knot. The sequence uses jump cuts to show the tightening and adjustment of the knot until it is perfectly formed. (5) A close-up shot focuses on his left wrist as he fastens a silver stainless steel watch with a blue dial. He then adjusts his shirt sleeve to rest neatly against the timepiece, demonstrating careful attention to his grooming and professional appearance. (6) The man takes the dark suit jacket and slides his arms into the sleeves. He adjusts the fit on his shoulders and smooths the lapels before buttoning the front. A small gold-colored pin is visible on the left lapel of the jacket. (7) In the final shot, the man stands tall and crosses his arms over his chest. He looks directly at the camera with a confident and friendly smile, fully dressed in his formal attire and appearing ready for a professional engagement.
